summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results via press release dated November 10, 2026. Revenue was $2,048,425, down 5.0% year over year, with gross profit of $128,957 and a 6.3% margin, or 24.2% excluding a $366,609 non-cash inventory write-down. Comprehensive loss was $13,032,744, and cash stood at $128,605,465 versus $90,156,821 at year-end 2025. The company highlighted selection by the Government of Canada for up to 5,000 tactical ISR systems. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; watch procurement conversion and cash burn.
